purpose: Requirements for formal document references by document ID, link checking, path-fix notification, change-impact candidate notification, and inconsistency checks, including output split into counts and a detail file.
summary: FR-007: formal references use reference-link definitions whose title holds a content hash and a DLID
FR-009: link checks search the referenced directory and verify DLID, current path, relative path resolution and fragments
FR-010: path-fix notification, including looking up moved documents in the current Index target list
Section 13.1: section IDs (DLIDs) placed at the end of every heading to reference sections stably
FR-013 to FR-015: enumerating direct referrers when a recorded content hash differs from the current hash, with no stored notification state
FR-016: inconsistency check items, user confirmation before rewriting, and the stdout counts plus detail file output contract
Acceptance criteria AC-003 to AC-035 covering path mismatch, impact listing, directory-search verification, title values, rewrite confirmation and detail files
Boundary that doc-link never rewrites link definitions or target documents; the project management AI does
tasks: Writing or revising reference links between documents
Designing or implementing change impact detection (check-impact)
Implementing path mismatch and moved-document detection
Designing inconsistency check output and detail files
Rewriting link titles with content hashes and DLIDs
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 参照と変更通知
